title: Sweet Potato and Green Lentil Coconut Curry
summary: A hearty Indian-inspired vegan curry with tender sweet potato, earthy green lentils and a creamy coconut milk sauce. It is warming, gently spiced and ideal for a comforting weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: sweet potato, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until soft and lightly golden.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the curry powder, cumin, ground coriander, turmeric and cayenne, and cook for 30 seconds to toast the spices.
Add the rinsed green lentils, sweet potato cubes, canned tomatoes, vegetable stock, salt and black pepper. Stir well, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cover partly with a lid and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the sweet potato is soft but still holding its shape.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer uncovered for 5–8 minutes, until the curry is creamy and slightly thickened. If it becomes too thick, add a splash of water.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Turn off the heat and stir through the lime juice.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Scatter with chopped fresh coriander and serve hot.
